name: Buying Plan
job: Own supplier-routed shortages, pack rounding, discounts, and theoretical buying cost
incomingHandoff: A saved monthly plan has ingredient demand and current stock, but the manager needs an orderable supplier basket.
outgoingHandoff: The manager has supplier-grouped whole-pack quantities, expected cost, pack overflow, missing-price warnings, and a handoff to receipt capture.
responsiveBehaviour: Keep supplier totals and warning states visible; allow the order table to scroll without clipping quantities or actions.

layoutContract.containment: Content remains in normal flow with explicit internal padding and no overlap.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: Choose and document a semantic experience before adding movement.
